facts.business: Shayona Engineering Limited provides engineering and manufacturing solutions across precision machining, heavy fabrication, dies & moulds, casting, forging, industrial automation, turnkey project execution, and manufacture of PVC and HDPE pipes and fittings.

segments.name: PVC and HDPE pipes and fittings (Menpura Division)

capacity_or_capex.item: Menpura Division manufacturing facility (PVC/HDPE pipes & fittings)
IPO proceeds earmarked for plant and machinery purchase

auditor.name: M/s. SGPS & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on IPO proceeds utilization: ₹247.81 lakh earmarked for plant & machinery remained unutilized as at March 31, 2026; ₹105.84 lakh temporarily invested in fixed deposits and ₹141.97 lakh used for interim working capital, subsequently made available before financial statements approval.

key_risks: Working-capital absorption increased with higher trade receivables (₹2,182.32 lakh) and net cash used in operating activities (₹579.57 lakh)
EBITDA margin moderated to ~18.78% from 22.17% as operating cost base grew faster than EBITDA
New piping operations at Menpura Division commenced only in last quarter of FY2025-26, contribution below segment reporting threshold
Dependence on customer capital expenditure, tender/project conversion, and execution capability
Competitive intensity, input pricing, regulatory requirements, and distribution development for piping products
